summary_en: 526,000 shares (3.2% S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired. Upper limit ¥2.0B. Period 2026/08/07–2026/12/30. Methods: ToSTNeT-3 and trust-bank purchase. Rationale: capital-efficiency improvement and sustained shareholder return aligned with mid-term plan targeting 8.5% ROE by FY12/35 and ¥5B aggregate buyback over five years.
title_en: Notice on Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
On 6 August 2026, Fukuda Corporation's board resolved to acquire its own ordinary shares under the authority granted by the company's articles of article 35, as permitted by the Companies Act. The buyback targets an upper limit of 526,000 shares (3.2% of shares outstanding excluding treasury as of 1 July 2026) with a maximum expenditure of ¥2.0 billion. The acquisition window runs from 7 August 2026 to 30 December 2026. Purchases will be executed via two methods: ToSTNeT-3 (off-hours, open-market trading on the Tokyo Stock Exchange) and trust-bank acquisition.

The rationale centers on capital-efficiency improvement and sustained shareholder return. The company's Medium-Term Plan 2030 aims for an 8.5% ROE target by December 2035, a 50% dividend payout ratio target by December 2030, stable dividend continuity, and approximately ¥5 billion in total treasury acquisitions over five years. This buyback aligns with that multi-year capital-allocation framework.

As of 1 July 2026, the company had 16,400,060 shares issued and outstanding (excluding 1,576,162 treasury shares). The price ceiling per share is not disclosed in the notice.
